On its face this reads as the same authoring claim remasured stale in one place and left standing in another, which would be a MUST-FIX of exactly the class this review is aimed at — particularly since g30-fixture-corpus.v2 namedCorpusClassCoverage covers all three of those classes and its liveCellMemberCoverage maps all seven live-cell members to authored files.
namedCorpusNotAuthoredRetentionTest.resolution: Refuted on precedent and on field semantics. The top-level field is a structural constant naming the gate's corpus classes, not a live authoring measurement: it is byte-identical across every version of every leftover-join in the register — g08 v1-v5, g09 v1-v12, g12, g15, g16, g18, g19, g20, g22, g23 v1-v8, g24 through g29, and g30 v1-v5 — including lineages whose fixtures are long since authored. The decisive parallel is g23-leftover-join.v8, which is the same act one stage further along and carries dual ACCEPT 0/0: it retains its top-level namedCorpusNotAuthored verbatim while emptying obligations[OBL-G23-FX-AUTHORING].namedCorpusNotAuthored to [], with the reason phrased on the identical template ('g23-fixture-corpus.v3 (D-237; dual ACCEPT 0/0) authors implementations of all four g23-input-corpus.v1 initial states. leftover-design of those four implementations is therefore stale as an authoring claim.'). The obligation-level copy is the live measurement and the subject remasures it correctly; the top-level copy is lineage identity. The subject follows the accepted convention exactly.

decision: ACCEPT - 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Ten attacks run, ten refuted against live bytes. Subject unmoved at f5ca1291 mode 0444, 24752 bytes, start and end. 48 digest checks across recordedInputs and embedded path/sha256 pairs pass with zero mismatches, plus seven fixture-file checks against the D-317 catalog. HEAD, COORD, file 08, required-now 28, the DR-G30 OPEN token and D-318 last-heading custody all reproduce; six cited commit subjects reproduce. The distinguishing claim holds in both halves against the bytes that establish it rather than against the subject's account of them: g30-fixture-corpus.v2 authors seven implementations covering four g30-input-corpus.v1 initial states and three occupancy v2 not-that-gate retained-evidence members, so leftover-design of those implementations is genuinely stale; and its whatIsNotAuthored plus an empty leftoverDesignClosedIfAcceptedAndRecorded, together with a fixtures/g30.v1/ directory holding seven files and no platform subdirectory, establish that per-D-002-platform copies genuinely remain. leftoverDesign stays [OBL-G30-FX-AUTHORING], matching what live COORD D-317 expressly deferred to this remasurement. The four platform members are quoted byte-exact and order-exact from occupancy v2 $.platforms, not minted. The one substantive challenge raised — a top-level namedCorpusNotAuthored retained while the identically named obligation-level field is emptied — was investigated and refuted against the dual-ACCEPT g23-leftover-join.v8 precedent, which is the same act one stage further along and uses the identical convention. No version deictic and no unstemmed leftover-join token survives; the subject additionally repairs an unstemmed token its own predecessor carried.
